description: Rohdaten BfG-GNSS-Messnetz is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GDI-DE. Das BfG-GNSS-Messnetzes besteht aus über 50 GNSS-Stationen im Bereich der Nord- und Ostsee. Primärer Zweck ist die Georeferenzierung von Pegeln der Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung (WSV). Die Rohdaten umfassen die kontinuierlichen Beobachtungsdaten der Satellitensysteme GPS, Glonass, Galileo und Beidou. Coverage: GDI-DE. The portal files it under the publisher GDI-DE. Its tags are aalb, bkal, eilx, einf, eito. The portal shows 2026-07-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support positioning and survey control studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
